# `fnox plugin link`

- **Usage:** `fnox plugin link [-f --force] <NAME> <PATH>`

Link a local plugin directory, for plugin development

## Arguments

- **`<NAME>`** — Plugin name
- **`<PATH>`** — Plugin directory containing provider.lua

## Flags

- **`-f --force`** — Replace an existing plugin with the link
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- fnox examples:start -->

## Examples

Installs a plugin as a symlink to a local directory, so edits take effect without reinstalling. fnox plugin update skips linked plugins.

```sh
fnox plugin link corp ~/src/fnox-plugin-corp
fnox plugin link corp ./plugin --force
```
